title: The `.dstest` Test Language
preamble:
# The `.dstest` Test Language

The `.dstest` test language **surface**. Prefix `LTSL`.

This document specifies the author-facing surface of a DS test: the `test` block
and its `initial` / `inputs` / `responses` / `produces` sections, the time model,
and the construction-versus-matching rules. It is the language companion to the
runtime execution contract ([RTIM]), the lowering-to-atoms contract ([RLOW.17]), and
the compiled test-atom registry (the `Test*` / `Oracle*` families, [RDSC.7.1]). The
substrate a test runs over — the single deterministic clock, the event-trace
primitive, the introspection surface — remains specified in [LTES]; `.dstest` is
the author language over that substrate.

`.dstest` is the whole author-facing test surface ([LTES.7.6]).
